profile.headline: Software Engineer — AI Product & Frontend Architecture | Building the shared infrastructure that lets AI teams ship faster
profile.summary:
Software engineer specializing in AI-native product development, with 15+ years building at scale — from Google's $90B+ Ads platform to Netflix's Globalization tools to AI agent systems at Oscilar.

My background is in mathematics (dual MSc), which shows up in how I work: I care about the foundations that let teams build faster, not just the feature in front of me. At Google, code I designed stayed in production for seven years. At Oscilar, the GenAI framework I built is now used across three product lines without rework. Separately, a code-review framework I built and open-sourced now gates every pull request my team ships.

Current focus: full-stack AI engineering — shipping AI agent features end-to-end across backend, API, AI layer, and frontend. The problems I gravitate toward sit at the intersection of technical depth and real stakes: enterprise customers, compliance use cases, P0 deadlines.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Identified a scaling risk in AI-assisted code review, then built and open-sourced an automated quality-gate framework (dotharness); adopted organically by the frontend team and now delivering static-analysis feedback on 350+ pull requests per month.

- Built the GenAI chat framework now used across three product lines — GenAI DAG Generation, GenAI Analytics, and GlobalAI — reducing per-feature AI integration to near-zero rework; early beta customers reported 80% faster workflow building.

- Shipped Rule Recommendations Agent (for workflow optimization) frontend end-to-end from scratch — recommendations panel, performance analytics, filtering, and feedback loop; recognized at launch as a "frequently requested feature and huge milestone."

- Delivered full workflow testing system supporting a 35K-record fintech deployment as a key contribution to a company-wide P0 initiative.

- Owned the expression system underpinning every workflow feature; extended and maintained it across 5+ downstream products without regression.

- Transitioned to full-stack AI engineering on the Fast AI Agents team, taking ownership of features end-to-end across API, AI backend, and frontend.

projects.title: Constraint-Driven Code Quality for AI-Assisted Teams (dotharness · vibe-heal · lens-flow)
projects.description:
A quality-gate architecture for teams shipping AI-assisted code, built as three single-purpose open-source tools rather than one bundled reviewer:

— dotharness (github.com/alexeieleusis/dotharness) — the harness that orchestrates PR review: runs deterministic checks and AI-agent judgment as separate stages, with git-revert containment and back-pressure at every step, so agent output stays cheap to inspect and undo before it ships.

— vibe-heal (github.com/alexeieleusis/vibe-heal) — the deterministic static-analysis engine that runs the same complete check on every commit and PR.

— lens-flow (github.com/alexeieleusis/lens-flow) — static-analysis rules that encode type-system-driven design knowledge, enforced mechanically rather than left to review judgment.

Started as a personal practice of gating my own pull requests; peers noticed and asked in, and it's since become my team's standard review infrastructure, now processing 350+ PRs a month.

https://github.com/alexeieleusis/dotharness
